Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.util

Class SplitMixRng

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.util.SplitMixRng
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rng
public class SplitMixRng extends Object implements Rng
Deterministic random number generator based on the SplitMix64 algorithm.

The whole generator state is a single long, which can be read with state() and restored with setState(long). Saving a game therefore preserves exactly where every random stream was, and the same seed always produces the same sequence on every platform.
